title: An interval certificate for a relativistic elastic ball beyond the Buchdahl compactness value
description: Article and two interval certificates for one fixed relativistic elastic material and central value. Full continuous DEC, nonnegative pressures, five principal-direction wave speeds, and surface 2M/R > 8/9. Numerical exceedance is known from Alho, Natario, Pani and Raposo. No arbitrary-angle causality, stability or physical material viability claim. Lean L1 statement only. Code Apache-2.0; original text and data CC BY 4.0.
